## Quick checklist

- [ ] No real credentials, IBANs or personal data anywhere (code, tests, fixtures, description).
- [ ] Tests added or updated where it makes sense.
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are explained below.
- [ ] If an AI tool wrote a large part of this, I said so and I've tested it myself.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`). CI will tell you if not, and we can help.
